request: Add a 2 millimetre fillet to the edges of the scrolling wheel slot to ensure a smooth surface.

actions.target: Edges of the scrolling wheel slot
actions.relational_constraint: The fillet is to be applied to the edges bounding the scrolling wheel slot.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the scrolling wheel slot in the CAD model and determine which edges bound that slot.
steps: Activate the main housing solid for editing and temporarily hide or suppress the separate control-wheel solid in section S08 so that the complete slot boundary can be selected without modifying the wheel.

Locate the rectangular control-wheel recess in section S07 near the longitudinal centerline of the upper housing. Confirm its identity from the multiview images by its position around the projecting green control wheel and from the model data by its four planar walls and open top.

Identify the exposed slot rim as the four edges shared by the convex upper deck face 0000 (B-rep FACE 6) and the four recess walls: pocket left wall face 0006 (FACE 0), pocket rear wall face 0007 (FACE 1), pocket right wall face 0008 (FACE 2), and pocket front wall face 0009 (FACE 3).

Exclude the lower edges where the four pocket walls meet pocket floor face 0010 (FACE 4), because those edges are internal to the recess rather than the exposed scrolling-wheel slot rim. Also exclude all faces and edges of the separate control wheel in section S08.

Start a constant-radius edge-fillet feature on the main housing. No construction plane, sketch, extrusion, or separate chamfer feature is required because the requested modification is a direct blend of existing B-rep edges.

Select all four upper perimeter edges of the recess, including the two longitudinal edges adjacent to faces 0006 and 0008 and the two transverse end edges adjacent to faces 0007 and 0009. Use explicit edge selection rather than unrestricted tangent propagation so that the fillet does not continue onto unrelated upper-deck perimeter edges.

Set the fillet type to a constant-radius rolling-ball blend and set the radius to exactly 2 millimetres. Apply the blend into the material of the main housing so that it rounds the sharp transition from upper deck face 0000 into the recess walls.

Resolve the four slot-rim corners with the CAD system's compatible corner-transition solution, maintaining a continuous 2 millimetre blend around the complete rectangular opening and avoiding gaps, overlaps, or self-intersections.

Regenerate the model and verify that the new blend faces trim only section S01 and the upper portions of section S07. Confirm that pocket floor face 0010, the lower wall-to-floor edges, the external housing surfaces, and the separate wheel solid remain unchanged.

Restore the visibility of the control wheel and inspect the result in top, front, side, and top-right isometric views. Confirm that the wheel remains centered within the recess, can project through the opening, and does not intersect the new 2 millimetre fillets over its intended rotational envelope.

Perform a final B-rep validity and clearance check, confirming that the housing remains a closed solid, the four fillets form a smooth continuous slot rim, and adequate clearance remains between the rounded opening and wheel tread faces 0012 and 0013 and wheel side faces 0011 and 0014.
